svg.text: MoE decoder on mesh {'data': 2, 'expert': 2, 'fsdp': 2} of 8 simulated CPU devices, 8 experts, top-2, dispatch=exchange
Arrows: routed slots a device sends to another for this batch, summed over the MoE layers (d, e, f = data, expert, fsdp coordinate).
Probe: one fixed validation batch of 16 x 32 bytes; the last frame routes the generated text.
